name: diag_e2e_look_anchor_projection_01
command:
import hashlib, json, math
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from src.envs.pair_v2_projection_pool import camera_from_metadata, project_point
from src.envs.pair_v2_bbox_rank import project_box
from src.tools.t01_partition import audited_result
name='diag_e2e_look_anchor_projection_01'
root=Path.cwd().resolve()
data,ref=audited_result(root/'results/smoke_e2e_look_views_01_retry2.json')
failed=data['metrics']['exports'][0]
raw=Path(failed['scratch_directory'])/'raw'
def read(reference):
 p=Path(reference['file']).resolve(); body=p.read_bytes()
 assert len(body)==reference['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()==reference['sha256']
 return body
index=json.loads(read(failed['raw_index']))
refs={Path(x['file']).name:x for x in index['files']}
package=json.loads(read(failed['source_package']))
anchor=package['anchor_name']
rows=[];frames=[]
bounds=[241,235,255,255]
for world,frame in enumerate(('000135','000138')):
 metadata_ref=refs['frame_'+frame+'_metadata.json']
 metadata=json.loads(read(metadata_ref))
 obj=next(o for o in metadata['objects'] if o['name']==anchor)
 camera=camera_from_metadata(metadata,metadata_ref)
 projected=project_box(obj['axisAlignedBoundingBox']['center'],obj['axisAlignedBoundingBox']['size'],camera)
 gap=None
 if projected['projectable']:
  b=projected['rectangle_px']
  dx=max(bounds[0]-b['right'],b['left']-bounds[2],0)
  dy=max(bounds[1]-b['bottom'],b['top']-bounds[3],0)
  gap={'dx_pixels':dx,'dy_pixels':dy,'euclidean_pixels':math.hypot(dx,dy)}
 rows.append({'world':'w'+str(world),'metadata_reference':metadata_ref,'position':obj['position'],
  'rotation':obj['rotation'],'aabb_center':obj['axisAlignedBoundingBox']['center'],
  'aabb_size':obj['axisAlignedBoundingBox']['size'],'projected_aabb':projected,
  'position_projection':project_point(obj['position'],camera),
  'diff_region_rectangle_pixel_edges':bounds,'projected_rectangle_min_gap_to_diff':gap})
 image_ref=refs['frame_'+frame+'_rgb.png'];read(image_ref)
 frames.append(np.asarray(Image.open(image_ref['file'])).astype(np.int16))
delta=frames[1]-frames[0];mask=np.abs(delta).max(axis=2)>3
summary={'source':ref,'raw_index':failed['raw_index'],'pair_id':failed['pair_id'],'anchor_name':anchor,'worlds':rows,
 'signed_rgb_change_w1_minus_w0_in_gt3_region':{'negative_channels':int((delta[mask]<0).sum()),
 'positive_channels':int((delta[mask]>0).sum()),'equal_channels':int((delta[mask]==0).sum()),
 'mean_RGB':delta[mask].mean(axis=0).tolist()},
 'limitation':'Projected AABB and a 2D floor patch do not identify causal shadow/reflection or a 3D light path; no depth/light buffer or intervention is present.',
 'scope':'Existing authenticated raw only, geometry is diagnostic, no scientific acceptance changed.'}
out=root/'logs/runs'/name;out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
(out/'diagnostic.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,sort_keys=True,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
print('DIAGNOSTIC_JSON: '+json.dumps(summary,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False),flush=True)
